notes.text: I-akhawunti engenayo i-Google noma i-Apple manje iyasuswa ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 ingasetshenziswa. Isikrini sokwamukela ne-Iphrofayela kuyakusho lokho, futhi ukuxhuma i-Google noma i-Apple kugcina idatha yakho.
Manje ungalinganisa i-app ku-Iphrofayela › Usizo nempendulo, ngokuthi "Linganisa i-app".
Isindleko esivulwe ku-Ikhaya noma ku-Zonke izindleko manje sibuyela ngqo lapho usivule khona, singadluli eqenjini laso.
Kulungisiwe ibhamuza elithi "+N" lesitaki sobuso elalivela ngaphansi kobuso bokuqala esikhundleni sokuba phezu kwabo.
